description: This file defines the HtmlResponse class, which is a specialized HTTP response class for returning HTML content in a server response. It extends a base Response class and includes methods to construct an HTML response with proper headers and content handling.

classes.name: HtmlResponse
classes.description: A class for creating HTML HTTP responses with default content-type and status, supporting content as string or stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an HTML response object, setting content, status code, and headers.

methods.name: createBody
methods.description: Creates a stream body from the provided HTML string or stream interface, throwing exception if invalid.
